title: Singapore, Germany test cross-border payments to reduce settlement risk
reason: Named central-bank-adjacent cross-border settlement test using zero-knowledge proofs, a real infrastructure milestone.

sources.summary: Zero-knowledge proofs let each ledger verify the other leg was locked, so neither currency settled unless both did, with no shared ledger or intermediary.

title: JPMorgan and DBS let clients move dollars across borders on weekends
reason: Major banks connecting blockchain deposit networks for 24/7 tokenized dollar transfers is a significant institutional infrastructure development.

sources.summary: DBS and JPMorgan have connected their blockchain-based deposit networks, letting approved clients move tokenized U.S. dollars between Singapore and the U.S. at any time, including weekends.
